content.rendered: We hope you can join us Thursday, September 21st 6:00-7:30 for our Back to School Night. This is a great opportunity for parents to learn what your child’s day will look like in their classroom and what they will be learning throughout the year.  The teacher will share day to day routines, procedures and expectations. To start the evening you will gather in our cafeteria and hear a message from our principal, Jon Wollmuth, and a few other messages.  This evening is for parents only.  If you need any further information, please contact our front office at 503-825-5300.
